task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the transition directive file on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of 'uk_transition_directive.txt' on the desktop.

task_completion.description: Update Organization Name to 'EcoPower Energy UK' and Organization Code to 'ECO-UK'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Organization Configuration or General Settings page showing 'EcoPower Energy UK' in the name field and 'ECO-UK' in the code field.

task_completion.description: Update Timezone to 'Europe/London' and Date Format to a UK standard (Day-first).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Settings or Localization page showing the Timezone dropdown set to 'Europe/London' and Date Format set to 'dd-mm-yyyy' or similar day-first format.

task_completion.description: Create a new location named 'London Global HQ' with correct city and country.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Add Location' form or the Location List showing 'London Global HQ' with City 'London' and Country 'United Kingdom'.

task_completion.description: Deactivate the legacy 'New York HQ' location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Location List showing 'New York HQ' with a status of 'Inactive', 'Deactivated', or the agent clicking the delete/deactivate icon for that specific entry.

integrity.description: The agent performed the updates through the HRMS web interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser interacting with the Sentrifugo HRMS UI, not just executing SQL commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the UI by editing the database directly via command line.
integrity.visual_evidence: Absence of terminal commands like 'mysql -e' or 'update' queries targeting the organization tables.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system to find the settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking on 'Configuration', 'Organization', or 'Settings' menu items.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must update the HRMS with these exact values: Organization Name: 'EcoPower Energy UK', Organization Code: 'ECO-UK', Timezone: 'Europe/London', Date Format: Day-first (e.g., DD/MM/YYYY). It must create a new location 'London Global HQ' (City: London, Country: United Kingdom, Timezone: Europe/London) and deactivate the existing 'New York HQ' location. All actions should be performed within the Sentrifugo HRMS web application.
